name: Celestial Seed Vault
description: A vault deep within a crystal asteroid, storing glowing seeds that contain entire miniature worlds.
prompt: Inside a massive crystal asteroid, a high‑tech vault with rows of illuminated pods. Futuristic, awe‑inspiring, macro detail, 8K.
caption: Worlds waiting to sprout 🌱💫 #SeedVault
